title: IIMS International Hackathon 3.0, technical lead
summary: I was technical lead for IIMS International Hackathon 3.0, powered by Perceptron AI, which meant owning the build plan, the tooling and the review rhythm rather than only my own track. Organising it was the clearest evidence I had that I could hold a technical decision for other people, not just make one.
